messages.content: Explain how an airplane wing generates lift. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: As an airplane moves forward, its wings slice through the air and force the airflow downward. Because of the wing's tilted angle and curved shape, air flows faster over the top surface than underneath, which creates lower air pressure on top and higher pressure below. This pressure difference, combined with the physical reaction of the air being deflected downward, pushes the wing upward to create lift.
